sql: CREATE TABLE dept ( id serial PRIMARY KEY, name varchar(30) NOT NULL UNIQUE, code char(3) DEFAULT 'ABC', budget numeric(12,2) DEFAULT 0, active boolean DEFAULT true, opened date, at timestamp, atz timestamptz, t time, tiny smallint, mid integer, f4 real, f8 double precision, data bytea, doc jsonb, uid uuid, tags text[], note text DEFAULT 'x', made text DEFAULT to_char(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'), stamp timestamptz DEFAULT now(), CONSTRAINT dept_budget_chk CHECK (budget >= 0), CONSTRAINT dept_code_chk CHECK (code ~ '^[A-Z]{3}$'), CONSTRAINT dept_note_chk CHECK (note = ANY (ARRAY['x', 'y'])) )
COMMENT ON COLUMN dept.note IS 'a comment'

CREATE TABLE emp ( id bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, dept_id integer REFERENCES dept ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE RESTRICT DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, boss bigint REFERENCES emp(id) ON DELETE SET NULL, name text NOT NULL COLLATE "C", double_id integer GENERATED ALWAYS AS (dept_id * 2) STORED )
CREATE TABLE link (a integer, b integer, PRIMARY KEY (a, b), FOREIGN KEY (a) REFERENCES dept(id))
CREATE TABLE noident (id integer GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY, k text, PRIMARY KEY (id, k))
CREATE INDEX emp_dept ON emp (dept_id DESC)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX emp_boss ON emp (boss) WHERE boss IS NOT NULL
CREATE INDEX emp_lower ON emp (lower(name))
CREATE INDEX emp_hash ON emp USING hash (name)
CREATE INDEX emp_incl ON emp (dept_id) INCLUDE (name)
CREATE INDEX emp_partial_bad ON emp (dept_id) WHERE name ~~ 'a%'
CREATE VIEW emp_names AS SELECT name FROM emp
CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW emp_m AS SELECT name FROM emp
CREATE FUNCTION noop() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ BEGIN RETURN NEW; END $$
CREATE TRIGGER emp_t BEFORE INSERT ON emp FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION noop()
